international.title: Manchester’s Co-op Live arena evacuated after ‘unknown substance’ released in crowd
international.summary: Police declare major incident after concertgoers at Don Toliver gig report eye and respiratory symptoms One person was taken to hospital and more than 50 were assessed by medics after a substance was let off in the crowd at Manchester’s Co-op Live arena, officials have said. Police declared a major incident after the release of the substance, which was initially thought to be teargas, as they sought to protect the 12,000 people in the crowd at a Don Toliver concert.
